questions.stem: A 5-year-old boy complains about 3 weeks history of whooping cough. Which of the following acts as a key virulence factor of this patient.
questions.explanation: ไอกรน (pertussis) virulence factor: filamentous hemagglutinin (FHA)

option_why.A: pili ไม่ใช่หลัก

questions.stem: What is mechanism of Co-trimoxazole

questions.stem: ข้อใดบ่งบอกว่าเป็น bactericidal antibiotic
